name: Zui's Witch Academy
description:
About This Game

Zui's Witch Academy is a boss rush roguelike-styled action game. You build a deck of 3 magical cards to take down one of many bosses. Each boss has an arena specifically tailored to them. Can you help Rysa graduate from Zui's Witch Academy with flying colors?

This game was originally made for the Boss Rush 2025 Game Jam!

Features

  • 18 unique cards to collect and build your deck with!

  • 3 difficulties to attempt and conquer, I doubt you can beat impossible mode (no like seriously, give up).

  • Practice and master against every boss in training mode.

  • 8 bosses each with their own arena specifically designed around them.

  • An energetic and fun soundtrack! Complemented by a charming modern pixel-art aesthetic.

What are you waiting for?

The game is free! Download it and play it now! Rysa is waitin' for you to wake her up, how else is she going to graduate from Zui's Witch Academy?
short_desc: Welcome to Zui's Witch Academy, a boss rush roguelike-styled game that encourages creativity by building decks to face off against skilled bosses in a row to beat the game. Choose your selection of magical cards to take down 8 uniquely designed bosses!
